description: This header file defines the App2AppProvider class, a plugin for the WPEFramework that provides app-to-app messaging and discovery services via JSON-RPC. It includes class declarations, method signatures, event handlers, and configuration details for the plugin.

classes.name: App2AppProvider
classes.description: A plugin class that provides app-to-app messaging and discovery services via JSON-RPC, including methods for registration, messaging, and event handling.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A configuration class for App2AppProvider, containing settings such as enabled state, provider ID, and capabilities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: endpoint_ping
methods.description: Handles the ping JSON-RPC request, responding with 'pong'.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the plugin, such as name, version, and state.

methods.name: endpoint_configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message from one app to another.

methods.name: RegisterAppInternal
methods.description: Internal method to register an app.

methods.name: UnregisterAppInternal
methods.description: Internal method to unregister an app.

methods.name: IsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if an app is registered.
